tasks.label: beebasm: fast3d
tasks.detail: Assemble the demo to a bootable disc, with the symbols and listing the debugger reads, and the routines alone for check.mjs
tasks.command: beebasm -i demo.6502 -do build/fast3d.ssd -boot DEMO -v -dd -labels build/demo.labels > build/demo.lst && beebasm -i checks.6502 -dd -labels build/checks.labels
